dsmz40_excluded_boundary.description: DSMZ40 inherits DSMZ29. In29, C uses50mLwater, D uses450mLwater plus0.5mLresazurin solution, and E uses25mLwater plus1mLtrace solution and solutes; the prepared C/D/E solutions are combined. TOGO M2477 section volumes50/450/25mL are provider group-volume claims, not measured final aliquots of those stocks. No final-volume or concentration calculation is asserted.
dsmz40_excluded_boundary.publication_authorization: None. Isolated review proposal only; every inherited source, ingredient and downstream publication hold remains.
dsmz40_excluded_boundary.mapping_consequence: Preserve exact preparation identity and has-part relations. Review native YAML/SSSOM synchronization at integration; no downstream rebuild is authorized.
publication_holds: Original source, exact form, owner, role, sibling/cross-shard and downstream release holds remain; fresh independent final-byte review required.
